Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules linked to document CHEMBL1140357. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, then inner join compound_structures on molregno to ensure canonical_smiles is present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.
